evidence.reason: The helper loader compiles the readable helper bytes at line 82 without catching SyntaxError. A malformed unpinned helper therefore escapes before the controller lock, and the asserted --json path cannot emit the required stdout error object while keeping stderr empty. The adjacent live-binding loader already translates SyntaxError into Refused, so the smallest compatible fix is to do the same at this helper-load boundary while retaining the hash-then-execute ordering.
